_note: Starting checklists and areas for the Safety & 5S app. Each question: checklist, no, English, Khmer, critical, photo on No, common problems ([English, Khmer]) for the What is wrong dropdown. The Apps Script copies them into the Checklists and Areas tabs once (setup); after that the tabs are the source. The app also uses these problems for a question whose Problems cell is empty, matched by its English text. The 8th field is the emoji shown before the question (the app finds it by the English text).
